meta.description: Implementation contract locking in all deterministic Python execution details before generating outcome statistics.

01_preprocessing.buildPanel: Generates a raw immutable panel only. No transformations applied.
01_preprocessing.foldTransformation: Transformations (winsorization, ECDF, z-score) occur strictly within OOS folds in scripts 03 and 04, using a shared train-only preprocessor function.
01_preprocessing.ecdfFormula: Count of train elements <= x / N_train
01_preprocessing.insufficientVariationPolicy: If training variance is 0, status becomes insufficient_training_variation

icBootstrap.passCondition: 95% moving-block percentile CI of Spearman IC must exclude zero in the expected direction.

03_baseline_models.baselineAsOfSession: last completed ^GSPC session strictly before F (firstTradableSession). Never use F close.

04_incremental_oos.testingScheme: Pooled OOS predictions generated via expanding window (annually refit).
04_incremental_oos.pooledTest: squared-error loss differential (d_t = e^2_baseline,t - e^2_enhanced,t) tested exactly once across the entire pooled OOS sequence.
04_incremental_oos.deltaR2: Descriptive output only. Not used for SUPPORTED gate.

05_robustness.grouping: Group eligible primary-hypothesis observations by firstTradableSession year and recompute Spearman IC.
05_robustness.nTotalDefinition: Sum of N for all eligible years
05_robustness.loyo: Drop one year, recompute aggregate Spearman IC. median(LOYO_IC) must have expected direction.
05_robustness.requirement: Both primary hypotheses must independently pass all regime rules.

06_multiple_testing.insufficientDataPolicy: If a hypothesis lacks data (N < 60, constant signal, etc.), its effective p-value is forced to 1.0. It is NOT removed from the BH family.

07_evidence_gate.secondaryHypothesisPolicy: Secondary hypotheses are completely ignored for the gate.
